Chikkamangudi, name of a temple dedicated to Cikkamma on the rim of the Moyar Ditch, 20.5 km. of Ootacamund; a Badaga and Kasava pilgrimage centre has recently grown up here, weekly worship is done by a Kasava priest and the annual ceremony falls in March, when over 10,000 people attend; in Badaga legend, said to be one of the seven frontier-shrines; < cikka+ amma+tgudi, ‘little+mother+ttemple’)
